text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I went into town with Still in Love.
Thinking she might need a break, I decided to make a suggestion.
choice_data_list: Looks like the nearby amusement park is holding a night parade.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...An amusement park...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I am very intrigued.
A dazzling parade, attractions...
Let us by all means enjoy them together.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: There are so many people... Everyone must be really looking forward to the parade.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If we were to get separated
in the middle of all this...
choice_data_list: Don't leave me, Still
Don't leave my side, Still.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yes.
I will always stay by your side...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting her to enjoy the amusement park,
I led her to a popular scream-inducing roller coaster, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
What a long line...
It really must be incredibly popular.
choice_data_list: Sorry, should we head somewhere else instead...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't mind the wait at all.
...I'm sure time will fly if I'm chatting with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Your favorite attractions.
Memories of the amusement park when you were little,
and the sights you still remember.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind,
please tell me... everything.
choice_data_list: In that case, I'd love to hear your story too.
In that case, I'd love to hear your story too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —My story, too...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes. Of course. Let's share...
many, many words together."

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Now, the moment you've all been waiting for!
Please enjoy the ultimate speed and thrill... to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Train Passengers
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, wah...!
Kyaaaah~~!!"
choice_data_list: Waaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Are you all right?
You're looking a bit pale...
choice_data_list: I thought my soul left my body...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed. That corkscrew spin like a tornado... It was a breathtaking rush of speed, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it would have been fine for me to shout at the top of my lungs together with you, Trainer...
choice_data_list: ...A-All right! Let's go try another thrill ride, then!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Giggle... No, I just feel like taking a short rest.
How about trying a more relaxing attraction next?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Taking a leisurely ride on an attraction with you...
I'm sure that would be wonderful too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how long had I been walking around the park
with her? Before I knew it, the sun had set—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"My, look at that.
Could that light over there be...?"
choice_data_list: Looks like the parade has started!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing. So many illuminations, sparkling in a dazzling burst of colors...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It's beautiful, isn't it?
It feels like we're in a fantasy world...
choice_data_list: It looks like a parade of stars, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed. The stars that have fallen from the night sky, shining upon people... It's that kind of light.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I'm truly glad we came to this amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'll ever forget this.
Every single ride we went on today... and this dazzling sight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you so happy...
I'm truly glad I showed you around this place.
choice_data_list: You really do love amusement parks, don't you?
You truly do love amusement parks, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...No, truth be told,
I hadn't really been interested up until now.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I've never been good with crowded places...
and getting lost terrified me, too.
Ever since I was little, I just sort of stayed away from them...
choice_data_list: Then why at an amusement park...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Look.
...The light is so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Still, the reason it looks so dazzling is—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It must be because...
I'm looking at the exact same thing you are.
choice_data_list: ...I wonder if that's just how things are.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...That's why, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I want to continue...
living in this world with you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry for blurting that out so suddenly...
B-But... that's how I truly feel...
choice_data_list: I'm glad I met you, too.
I'm so glad I got to meet you too.
Let's definitely go somewhere together again.
If I was able to support you, I'm honored.
If I was able to support you, then it's an honor.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry for blurting that out so suddenly...
B-But... that's how I truly feel...
choice_data_list: I'm glad I met you, too.
I'm so glad I got to meet you too.
Let's definitely go somewhere together again.
If I was able to support you, I'm honored.
If I was able to support you, then it's an honor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her ferocious running, as if ready to devour everything.
It burned itself into my mind and wouldn't leave.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No other Umamusume will do—
I want to chase this dream with her.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: So thank you for coming into my life.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —Ah...! N-No, I should be the one thanking you...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Being your Umamusume...
is the greatest happiness of my life, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yes!
Of course!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of world I'll get to see next...
My heart is already dancing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It's me who... is truly glad to have met you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please, continue to...
walk alongside me.
